scenarios.name: life-gain-replaced-with-nothing
scenarios.why: Any player who would gain life gains none instead. Setup permanents are in play for turn 1's upkeep, so the Vortex has already dealt seat 0 2 (20 -> 18); Revitalize then leaves seat 0 at 18 but still draws the card.

scenarios.name: each-upkeep-deals-two-to-active-player
scenarios.why: At the beginning of EACH player's upkeep it deals 2 damage to that player: seat 0 takes 2 in its own turn-1 upkeep (setup precedes turn 1), then seat 1 takes 2 in its turn-2 upkeep.
